overall_notes: The paper focuses on insight generation from databases using LLMs, which qualifies as an NLG task. Evaluation uses both automatic metrics (for Text-to-SQL correctness) and human/LLM evaluation (for insight quality). The extraction was generally accurate but required normalization and consolidation of duplicate entries. The paper has a strong evaluation methodology combining human judgment with LLM-based evaluation.
